metadata.description: Claude Code mods for keeping your focus while many agents work: side questions that never touch the main thread.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: /aside: a side pane for quick questions to a side model (haiku, sonnet, opus or fable) outside the main session, with an optional synopsis back to the prompt.

plugins.name: tangent
plugins.description: Ask a question between || pipes || (or your own delimiters) mid-sentence; the answer is written back into your draft in place.

plugins.name: ghostfox
plugins.description: A headless Firefox MCP for Claude, logged in wherever your everyday Firefox is (cookies and localStorage copied from your main profile).
